item.title: Experts, reporters and lawmakers dig into Nvidia reinstalling Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: Just days after Jensen Huang stepped down as Nvidia CEO following allegations he had an affair with an alleged Chinese, the chip maker reinstalled Huang to his position in a stunning reversal. President Trump took credit for intervening. Experts, reporters and lawmakers spoke with CBS News about how it affected the markets, what it could mean for national security, how it could impact the AI race with China and more.

item.title: Appeals court clears way for Army to detonate Iowa explosives
item.description: A federal appeals court on Monday declined to block the Army from detonating explosives containing lead azide at a munitions plant in Iowa.

item.title: A timeline of the Karen Read case
item.description: Here's a look at how events have unfolded in the Karen Read case.

item.title: Federal court releases Rep. Ilhan Omar D.C. home raid documents
item.description: A federal court on Monday evening released documents regarding last month's raid at the Washington, D.C. home of Democratic Minnesota U.S. Rep. Ilhan Omar.

item.title: Can Anthropic win hearts and minds by curing hearts and minds?
item.description: Anthropic says Claude Science can drive breakthroughs in drug discovery. It could also open lucrative commercial opportunities, experts say.

item.title: Trump downplays Iran's latest attacks as it vows to use all means to end U.S. blockade
item.description: The Iranian government said it would use "all available means" to end the U.S. naval blockade of the country's ports, dubbing it an "act of military aggression." CBS News Pentagon reporter Eleanor Watson has more.

item.title: Husband of woman arrested by ICE at airport calls it "unjust"
item.description: Jose Castillo told CBS News he felt "useless" seeing his wife and father-in-law be taken into federal custody at Seattle-Tacoma International Airport.

item.title: Anthropic touts potential for AI-led medical advancements
item.description: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei talked about his hopes to cure disease using artificial intelligence last Thursday, as his company started trading publicly. CBS News MoneyWatch reporter Megan Cerullo has more on how AI is speeding up drug discovery.

item.title: Santa school: where his official helpers learn to embody Old Saint Nick
item.description: Santa's official helpers are in training at the Charles H. Howard Santa School in Midland, Michigan. Hundreds of aspiring Saint Nicks and Mrs. Clauses gather every year at what's been called the Harvard of the trade. Tony Dokoupil has the story.

item.title: 9th measles death recorded in Pennsylvania amid ongoing outbreak
item.description: Pennsylvania's outbreak is the largest in the country​, with over 1,600 cases reported, and the deaths this year are the Keystone State's first from measles in 35 years.

item.title: Kate Middleton on cancer journey: "We're not meant to carry life's challenges alone"
item.description: The Princess of Wales, Kate Middleton, opened up about her cancer battle in a new documentary. Leigh Kiniry has more details from London.

item.title: Jensen Huang reinstatement as Nvidia CEO raising fresh national security concerns
item.description: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO Monday two weeks after Huang resigned amid a scandal over an affair with a woman U.S. intelligence agencies suspected of spying for China. CBS News national security contributor Joe Zacks and CBS News foreign correspondent Ramy Inocencio have more.

item.title: A look at the measles outbreak in Pennsylvania as it reports 9th related death this year
item.description: Measles cases are surging in the U.S., to the highest count it's seen in more than three decades. Pennsylvania has reported more than 1,600 confirmed cases and nine measles-related deaths in 2026 so far. Lilia Luciano reports from Lancaster County.

item.title: Zelenskyy says Ukraine sank Russian warship off Libya's coast
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said his country was behind attacks that sank a Russian warship and damaged a sanctioned cargo vessel off Libya.

item.title: Family of those arrested in chaotic ICE incident at Seattle airport speaks out
item.description: Immigration agents dragged a father and his adult daughter out of a jet bridge side door at a Washington state airport as they screamed for help. Camilo Montoya-Galvez spoke with the family.

item.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: Nvidia said Monday that it has restored Jensen Huang as the chipmaker's chief executive, calling him the "right person" to lead the company.

item.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang still testifying before Congress next week
item.description: Jensen Huang is still set to testify before lawmakers next week, congressional panels confirmed, after he was reinstated as Nvidia's CEO Monday, after resigning earlier this month amid allegations of affairs.

item.title: Huang's return at Nvidia puts spotlight on chipmaker's board
item.description: Nvidia directors' decision to rehire Jensen Huang shows a "lack of courage," according to one prominent governance expert.

item.title: Ukraine sinks Russian warships thousands of miles from battlefield near Libya
item.description: Military video posted by Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is said to show the country's naval drone attacks on Russian ships near Libya, thousands of miles from the battlefield. Charlie D'Agata reports.

item.title: Jensen Huang's announced return sends shares skyrocketing
item.description: Stocks soared on Monday, much of it on word that AI chipmaker Nvidia had reinstated its CEO, Jensen Huang, following his affair with an alleged Chinese spy. The move raised concerns about U.S. national security, even as it sent markets swinging up. Jo Ling Kent and Weijia Jiang have more details.

item.title: Nasdaq gains 6.5% after Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO
item.description: The Nasdaq Composite closed 6.5% higher, erasing all of its losses from Friday, when the index suffered its second-worst day of 2026.

item.title: Major storms threaten Thanksgiving travel, tech outages add to concerns
item.description: As Thanksgiving travel week began on Monday, Delta was still recovering from Sunday's tech outage. Adding to the uncertainty were two storm systems scheduled to hit both the East and West coasts later this week. CBS News senior transportation correspondent Kris Van Cleave reports.

item.title: Tech outages and impending storms causing Thanksgiving travel concern
item.description: Delta Air Lines flights resumed on Monday after a systemwide outage caused massive delays on Sunday. Meanwhile, authorities in San Francisco expressed concern about severe flooding that could impact airports and roads. Kris Van Cleave reports and Rob Marciano has the forecast.

item.title: Stocks soar after Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
item.description: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO on Monday, 11 days after he resigned over an affair he had with an alleged Chinese spy. Jessica Inskip, the director of investor research at StockBrokers.com, and CBS News' Arden Farhi have more.

item.title: Democrats announce 12 presidential primary debates
item.description: The DNC has announced a plan to hold 12 presidential primary debates, five next year, and seven in 2028. Democratic strategist Joel Payne and Republican strategist Kevin Sheridan join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: Is America's Future Dependent On One CEO?
item.description: Jensen Huang is back as Nvidia's CEO just eleven days after being ousted over an affair with an alleged Chinese spy. Powerful voices in tech, an extreme market dip, and the president himself are just some reasons for his return. David Feith, senior fellow at the Hudson Institute, says Huang has been wrong, and even dangerous, when it comes to chip security. He breaks down how much the country's AI future depends on one man.

item.description: In announcing the debate framework, DNC chair Ken Martin leaned heavily into one of his signature causes, ending dark money in politics.

item.title: Princess Kate reflects on healing in new documentary: "Cancer does change you"
item.description: The princess reflects on her cancer journey in the documentary and speaks to others about their experiences.
